scope: Proposition 5.3 (Microscopic initialization) of the manuscript “BKT universality for height and planar spin fields” (preprints/BKT-universality-for-height-and-planar-spin-fields-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e6a8df09e021c4a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 68. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After this first convolution and extraction of identical scalar factors in twisted and untwisted volumes, the plane activities have the form Kb 0(X, ϕ) = 1X={B} s 2 eB(ϕ) + P0(X, ϕ), ∥P0∥ ≤ C(s2 + z), z = e−cb . (5.11) Here eB is the gradient energy on the sites of the block, with the orientation average used in Lemma 4.5. Finite free or periodic grids have full initial norm at most C(|s| + z). For each fixed Cη < ∞, the same bound holds for twists with sup |η| ≤ Cη, with C allowed to depend on Cη. In an unchanged interior neighborhood the untwisted activities are the plane activities. In every neighborhood with a common lift λ of the twist, the twisted activities equal the corresponding untwisted activities evaluated at ϕ + λ.
